newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-MIDDLESEX WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST AUSTRALIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-MIDDLESEX WIN TOSS AND BAT AGAINST AUSTRALIA.

text.p: Middlesex won the toss and opted to bat on the opening day of a three-day match against the touring Australians on Saturday.
Middlesex -Paul Weekes, Jason Pooley, Mark Ramprakash (captain), Mike Gatting, Owais Shah, K.Brown, Keith Dutch, Richard Johnson, Angus Fraser, Phil Tufnell, T.Bloomfield.
Australia - Mark Taylor, Matthew Elliott, Greg Blewett, Mark Waugh, Stephen Waugh, Ricky Ponting, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Jason Gillespie, Glenn McGrath, Michael Kasprowicz.
